answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. Here, we adopt three popular metrics from multi-label classification : label-F1 (average F1 over labels), instance-F1 (average F1 over instances), and hamming loss measured on the predicted and groundtruth label sequences .

answer_4.quote: Here 96 test hashtags were sampled and two native Chinese speakers were invited to select the first three emotions occurred to them. ... Then, we asked the same annotators to review the hashtags and their emotions from votes, where they thought 75% and 76% voted emotions make sense to them.
answer_4.guideline: Select the first three emotions occurred to them and review if the voted emotions make sense.
